ds-modes-desc: Multiplayer and Shared screen launches for DS and 3DS games. Needs a streaming broker that reads RomM's multiplayer preference as the mode.
game-clock-desc: A "Game clock" button in the player: day, night, any date, or real time, per game.
intro: Overlay extensions running on this server. Ones that need a service outside RomM start off.
player-autosave-desc: One autosave per game and core, written on Quit, Save & Quit and tab close.
player-controls-desc: Games saved with EmulatorJS's stock pad map get RomM's default controls.
player-volume-desc: Volume slider and Mute that work on every core.
random-multi-desc: A navbar entry that opens a random game for two players or more.
reload-needed: Reload the page to apply the change. Other users get it on their next page load.
requests-desc: A Requests page to ask for missing games. Needs the romm-requests service under /ext/requests on RomM's origin.
save-failed: Could not save the extension setting.
